scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @velvet/contracts && (npm --workspace velvet-mvp-server run dev & npm --workspace velvet-mvp-client run dev & wait)
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @velvet/contracts && npm --workspace velvet-mvp-server run dev
scripts.dev:client: npm run build --workspace @velvet/contracts && npm --workspace velvet-mvp-client run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @velvet/contracts && npm --workspace velvet-mvp-server run build && npm --workspace velvet-mvp-client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @velvet/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @velvet/contracts && npm --workspace velvet-mvp-server run typecheck && npm --workspace velvet-mvp-client run typecheck && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @velvet/contracts && npm --workspace velvet-mvp-server run test && npm --workspace velvet-mvp-client run test
scripts.health: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ci: npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
